hypothesis: A single lower cutoff can stop very weak NOT_SURE matches such as the Helios-42 false answer without discarding most useful evidence.
instruction: Given a peer question, decide whether this local conversation contains information that directly helps answer it.

labels.ordinary_answerable: DIAG, SAFE, MIXED and INDEPENDENT records for the exact case are useful; NOISE and LOOKALIKE records are not useful.
labels.dispute_questions: INDEPENDENT, SAFE and all three COPY records belong to the requested dispute and are useful.

claim_boundary: This development sweep chooses a candidate cutoff on public synthetic questions. It does not validate that cutoff on unseen owner memory or whole-conversation inputs.
